home.description: Race on the same board. Open every safe square, change a hidden number, and expose your opponent’s lies.
home.accountHint: Local practice without sign-in. Use your existing account for online matches.
home.openHint: New safe squares fill your attack gauge.
home.attackHint: Change one unopened non-zero number by ±1.
home.accuseHint: Find a lie to reflect the attack. A wrong accusation stuns you.
rules.title: How to play
rules.win: Open all {{safe}} safe squares first. At {{minutes}}, the player with more open safe squares wins; equal progress is a draw.
rules.gauge: The zero opening starts at zero gauge. Newly opened safe squares fill the gauge up to {{gauge}}. A successful attack spends it; no candidate leaves it full.
rules.lies: At most {{lies}} hidden changes exist at once. Targets are chosen automatically where neighboring safe/mine locations are already provable from revealed numbers.
rules.stun: Opening a mine stuns you for {{mine}}. A correct accusation restores the number and stuns the attacker for {{reflect}}; a wrong accusation stuns you for {{wrong}}.
rules.flags: Flags are notes, not proof. Remove a flag before opening that square.
storage.title: Essential storage
storage.description: Language and accessibility preferences stay on this device. Local records and offline cache can be cleared in settings. Advertising consent is separate.
status.title: Online play is unavailable
status.description: You can return home and practise locally without an account.
settings.memory: Storage is unavailable. Preferences last only for this tab.
board.title: My board
board.helpText: Click to open, right-click to flag. Use arrow keys to move, Enter or Space to act, O/F/A to change mode and Shift+F10 for the cell menu. On touch screens, drag to pan, pinch to zoom and hold a cell for its menu. Accuse an opened number you can prove false.
match.title: Local bot match
match.reflected: Attack reflected: bot stunned for {{seconds}} s
match.unavailable: Local play is unavailable. Start a new match to try again.
match.rejected: That action could not be applied. Try another square.
tutorial.title: Try an attack and accusation
tutorial.trainingRules: Training example: 3 × 3, 2 mines, gauge 1. Normal matches: 16 × 16, gauge 20.
tutorial.memory: Tutorial status lasts only for this tab because storage is unavailable.
tutorial.wrongAction: Follow the current lesson action, then try again.
tutorial.open.title: 1. Open a safe square
tutorial.open.hint: Open {{cell}}. Its 2 proves both neighboring closed squares are mines. New safe squares fill your gauge.
tutorial.attack.title: 2. Send an attack
tutorial.attack.hint: Spend your full gauge. The target is chosen automatically using public proof. The bot then attacks you.
tutorial.reveal.title: 3. Reveal the changed number
tutorial.reveal.hint: Open {{cell}}. The two mines proven by the 2 let you deduce this square’s real number is 1. The displayed 2 is false.
tutorial.accuse.title: 4. Accuse the false number
tutorial.accuse.hint: Accuse {{cell}}. A correct accusation restores 1 and reflects a 2-second stun onto the attacker.
tutorial.complete.title: You reflected the attack!
tutorial.complete.hint: The number is restored to 1 and the bot is stunned. In normal play, open safe squares, build your gauge and use logic to expose lies.
daily.title: UTC daily puzzle
daily.reset: A new puzzle starts at 00:00 UTC. Your current board stays unchanged.
daily.rules: Open every safe square. Flags are notes. No opponent, attacks or changed numbers in this mode.
daily.unverifiedHint: Local completion and time are personal references. They are not a verified score or official ranking.
daily.practice: Practice attempt: your first local record stays unchanged.
daily.recordsHint: The first local completion for each puzzle is kept on this device, up to 30 puzzles.
daily.ranking: Official ranking requires server verification and is currently unavailable.
daily.shareHint: The mosaic shows only overall progress. It does not reproduce the board or reveal numbers, mines or your name.
daily.shareError: Sharing is unavailable or cancelled. Try copying the result or downloading a PNG.
daily.memory: Local storage is limited. Some records may last only in this tab.
daily.unavailable: This puzzle is unavailable. Start a new puzzle to try again.
daily.help: Click to open, right-click to flag. Arrow keys move, Enter or Space acts, O/F changes mode, and Shift+F10 opens the cell menu. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, or hold a cell for its menu.
offline.title: Offline play
offline.ready: Offline: cached local play is available. Online matches and official records require a connection.
offline.missing: Offline: this device has no ready cache. Connect once to prepare local play.
offline.updateHint: An update is ready. Return home in every open tab before applying it.
offline.error: The operation could not finish. Another tab may be playing, or storage may be unavailable. Try again from home.
offline.disabled: Offline cache is disabled on this device.
offline.cached: Public local play assets are cached on this device.
offline.notCached: The offline cache is not ready. Connect to prepare it.
offline.pendingHint: Official submission of local results is still being prepared; signing in does not submit them automatically. Pending results stay on this device.
offline.cleared: Local records and pending results deleted.
offline.clearConfirm: Delete personal records and pending replays on this device? This cannot be undone.
auth.title: Use an account you already have
auth.intro: Continue with a familiar sign-in service. No new password needed.
auth.privacy: We never collect or store passwords, and do not request email, real name, photo or phone permissions.
auth.failed: Sign-in did not finish. Try again or continue with local practice.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable. Local practice still works.
auth.nicknamePrivacy: This is your game nickname. You do not need to use your real name.
auth.nicknameHint: 2–16 characters, using letters and numbers from your language. Spaces inside the name are allowed.
auth.lastProvider: Keep at least one sign-in method.
auth.deleteConfirm: Delete the Liar Sweeper account for {{name}} and end all its sessions? Local practice records can be deleted separately in settings.
auth.unlinkConfirm: Disconnect {{provider}} and end all your sessions? Sign in again with a remaining method.
auth.deleted: Your Liar Sweeper account was deleted.
auth.unlinked: The sign-in method was disconnected. Sign in with a remaining method.
auth.manualApple: Open your Apple account settings to revoke this service’s connection directly.
auth.appleRetry: Apple connection revocation may be retried for up to 24 hours. The requested local action is already complete.
auth.reauthHint: Use a connected service to confirm access, then choose the original action again. The service may reuse its existing sign-in.
auth.error.auth_required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.error.auth_invalid: Check the input or refresh your account status before trying again.
auth.error.auth_unavailable: The account service could not respond. Retry when connected.
auth.error.auth_conflict: That sign-in is already connected elsewhere, or it is your last remaining method.
auth.error.reauth_required: Confirm your sign-in again before this action.
auth.error.auth_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.pendingHint: Official submission of local results is still being prepared; signing in does not submit them automatically. Pending results stay on this device.
queue.title: Quick match
queue.signIn: Sign in to play online. Local practice needs no account.
queue.nickname: Choose a game nickname before playing online.
queue.error: Online play could not respond. Check your connection and retry.
queue.disconnected: The match connection ended. Inputs are paused; check match status when connected.
queue.limit: The service is busy. Wait briefly and check again.
queue.stale: The match changed while the request was running. Check its current status.
queue.hint: You play on the same board. After 10 seconds without an opponent, the server matches you with a labelled bot.
queue.recording.failed: The result could not be saved.
friends.shareError: Sharing was canceled or unavailable. Copy the link instead.
friends.copyError: The link could not be copied. Select the room code and send it to your friend.
friends.invalid: Enter a valid eight-character room code.
friends.notFound: This room is unavailable or has expired. Check the code or create a new room.
friends.full: This room is full. Ask your friend for another invitation.
friends.closed: This room is no longer active for you. Create or join another room.
friends.explicitJoin: An invitation fills the code. You choose when to join.
friends.joinHint: Eight letters or digits, without I, O, 0 or 1. Lowercase letters are accepted.
friends.otherQueue: You are already waiting for a quick match. Return to the queue or cancel waiting.
